symptom: `create java action M.JA (C: M.Color) returns Boolean` with M.Color an enumeration passes `check --references` and `exec`; mxbuild then reports CE1613 "The selected entity 'M.Color' no longer exists" for the parameter (and for `returns M.Color`). Same for JavaScript actions and for a System enumeration (`System.DeviceType`). A bare name that is neither an entity nor an enumeration (`M.NoSuchThing`) also passed both and failed the same way. Only `C: enum M.Color` worked; describe of a correct action prints `Enum M.Color`, so a bare name in describe output is the symptom
cause: In a code-action signature a bare `Module.Name` parses as TypeEnumeration with ExplicitEnum=false (the TypeEnumeration/TypeEntity ambiguity), and `astDataTypeToJavaActionParamType` / `…ReturnType` turned every such name into a CodeActions$EntityType. A comment there said callers 'resolve it via resolveCodeActionParamType' — a function that never existed in the repo. Flows had the entity-then-enumeration fallback (buildMicroflowFromStmt, settleSystemEnumeration); Java and JavaScript actions never got it, and check had no signature pass for them at all
file: `mdl/executor/code_action_signature_types.go` (`settleCodeActionSignature`, called from `execCreateJavaAction` and `execCreateJavaScriptAction` before anything is written; `codeActionSignatureErrors`, wired into `validateWithContext` for CreateJavaActionStmt / CreateJavaScriptActionStmt); stale comment fixed in `mdl/executor/cmd_javaactions.go`; tests `mdl/executor/cmd_javaactions_bare_enum_935_test.go`; fixture `mdl-examples/bug-tests/java-action-935-bare-enumeration-type.mdl`
insight: **A comment naming a function is a claim — grep for the function.** The converter's comment made the bug look handled; `grep -rn resolveCodeActionParamType` returns only the comment. Settle the name BEFORE the converter (retype an enumeration as an explicit one) rather than teaching the converter to look things up: the converter has no context, and the existing explicit-enum path then does the write. Decide System names from `meta.SystemEnumerations` (systemEnumerations) — System entities are not in the project, so 'not an entity' is not evidence there. Keep check and exec on the same verdict: exec settles with the backend, check uses declaredTypeResolver (which also sees names the script creates), and neither resolves a `list of` element, because exec never refused one. Measured on a blank 11.13.0 app: the bug-test script gives CE1613 x5 with a pre-fix build (Java param, Java return, System enum param, JS param, JS return) and 0 errors fixed; describe -> exec reports 'already in sync'. The generated .java takes the enum as `String _c` and converts with `Color.valueOf`, i.e. the source generator already handled EnumerationType once the model said so
